_doc: mark: [V] verified by reading the licence or release note IN THIS SESSION; [S] assumed (prior knowledge or an agent report, source not opened); [?] unknown.
redistributable: true/false/null. null = unknown, which World4 treats as NO.

lag_years: years between the end of a data year and its publication. known_time(year) = 1 July of (year + lag_years). An assumption [S] unless stated; it stops a backtest from using what had not been published yet.
World4 vendors no third-party data: the Atlas files are installed from the Atlas repo (see atlas_manifest.json) and only their provenance is recorded here.

wpp.name: UN World Population Prospects 2024
used_in: world series and cohorts of the L0 (V1)
wpp.note: Years 2024+ are a PROJECTION published 2024-07, not data: known_time of all of them is 2024-07-11. F1 also reads the age-sex files of the R package PPgp/wpp2024 (wpp_manifest.json); their 1950-2023 estimates are revised history (revision leak not measured). V1 (current World3) reads the world aggregate (code 900): e0, TFR, crude rates, births and deaths (e01dt, tfr1dt, misc1dt at commit 2da7768, world_manifest.json), and the world mortality and fertility age patterns from the F1 files; V2 reads the same indicators by country and UNlocations.txt for the UN subregions.

owid_co2.name: OWID co2-data (Global Carbon Project 2024)
owid_co2.license: CC BY 4.0 (OWID's; the underlying data keeps its own)

owid_energy.name: OWID energy-data (Energy Institute Statistical Review; EIA)
owid_energy.license: CC BY 4.0 (OWID's); Energy Institute licence not verifiable
owid_energy.note: F3 pins OWID energy-data at commit f8de88a (energy_manifest.json): primary energy by source, Energy Institute breakdown for 79 countries, the rest imputed from electricity generation. Not vendored.

emdat.name: EM-DAT (CRED/UCLouvain), public extract
emdat.note: EM-DAT terms do not allow redistributing the data. Neither World4 nor the Atlas should publish it; see the F0 report.

gfn.name: Global Footprint Network NFA 2018 / 2025
gfn.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (Public Data Package, per research report 02)
gfn.note: Share-alike: validation target only, in a separate directory.

bhm_udel.name: Burke, Hsiang and Miguel (2015) replication data; U. Delaware v3.01

faostat_temp.name: FAOSTAT Temperature change on land (NASA GISTEMP)

gapminder.name: Gapminder fasttrack / open-numbers (UNEP-IRP; Hickel 2020; Harvard Growth Lab; WDI)
gapminder.license: CC BY 4.0 (Gapminder's); the underlying data keeps its own

owid_fiscal.name: ICTD/UNU-WIDER GRD, IMF Public Finances in Modern History, OECD SOCX + Lindert, Tanzi and Schuknecht (via OWID)
owid_fiscal.license: CC BY 4.0 (OWID's); the underlying data keeps its own

sipri.name: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database via OWID

macro_fin.name: Global Macro Database, IMF HPDD, Laeven-Valencia, Jorda-Schularick-Taylor

geopol.name: Powell and Thyne (coups), V-Dem RoW, Archigos, ATOP, WDI ODA

resources.name: OWID energy, reserves, giant fields, World Bank rents, nationalisations (Atlas curated table)

fair_calibration.name: FaIR calibration data 1.6.0 (calibrated, constrained ensemble; CMIP7 historical emissions and forcings)
fair_calibration.note: Licence read from the Zenodo record metadata in the F4 session (all versions of concept 7112539 are CC BY 4.0; resolves H17). The posterior was constrained with observed GMST up to 2023: climate parameters are in sample for any hindcast. Not vendored (climate_manifest.json).

hadcrut5.name: HadCRUT5 5.1.0.0 global annual mean surface temperature (Met Office Hadley Centre / CRU)
hadcrut5.note: Truth for GMST in W3/W4. Not vendored (climate_manifest.json).

fair_package.name: FaIR simple climate model, Python package 2.2.4
fair_package.note: Licence read from the installed package metadata in the F4 session. Software dependency (extra 'climate'); world4/sectors/_fair_step.py is derived from fair/fair.py (see NOTICE).

faostat_f5.name: FAOSTAT bulk files: QCL, RL, RFN, ESB, GT, FBSH, FBS
faostat_f5.license: CC BY 4.0 complemented by the FAO Statistical Database Terms of Use (no use in promoting a commercial enterprise)
faostat_f5.vintage: bulk files downloaded 2026-10-12 (FAO update dates in food_manifest.json)
faostat_f5.note: Licence read on fao.org (Statistical Database Terms of Use) in the F5 session. FAOSTAT revises its history and replaces the bulk files without versions: the manifest pins SHA-256 and a different file is a different vintage. Not vendored.

wdi_water.name: World Bank WDI ER.H2O.FWTL.K3 and ER.H2O.FWAG.ZS (from FAO AQUASTAT)
wdi_water.note: Agricultural freshwater withdrawals; sparse (AQUASTAT reports every ~5 years). Not vendored.

owid_co2_world.name: OWID co2-data, World rows (Global Carbon Budget; Maddison Project Database 2023; Energy Institute; HYDE and UN population)
owid_co2_world.license: CC BY 4.0 (OWID's; the underlying data keeps its own)
used_in: carbon and climate of the L0 (V4)
owid_co2_world.note: World population, GDP (single years before 2015: 1950, 1960, ..., 2010), fossil CO2 by fuel and primary energy. V2 also reads GDP by country (164 countries). Pinned by commit and SHA-256 (world_manifest.json). Not vendored. V4 also reads total fossil and industry CO2, land-use-change CO2 and their cumulative sums. V6 also reads emissions by fuel and their cumulative sums.

noaa_mlo.name: NOAA GML Mauna Loa annual mean CO2 (mirror datasets/co2-ppm on GitHub)
noaa_mlo.license: Public domain (US Government work); mirror under ODC-PDDL
noaa_mlo.note: Atmospheric CO2 above 280 ppm is the proxy for World3's persistent pollution index. Not vendored.

owid_food_supply.name: OWID owid-datasets: Food supply (FAO, 2020), World row (FAO Food Balance Sheets)
owid_food_supply.license: CC BY 4.0 (OWID's); FAO Statistical Database Terms of Use for the underlying data
owid_food_supply.note: kcal per person per day, and the vegetal-equivalent food World3 counts in (animal kcal x 7, computed from the kg of meat, milk, eggs and fish of the same sheet): the proxy for World3's food per person. Ends in 2013 (the old FBS methodology): FAOSTAT itself was not reachable in the V1 session. Not vendored.

owid_cereal_yield.name: OWID owid-datasets: Cereal yield index (World Bank WDI 2017), World row
owid_cereal_yield.note: Index 1961 = 100, the proxy for World3's land yield. Not vendored.

owid_hyde_land.name: OWID owid-datasets: Land Use Data - HYDE (2017), World row (HYDE 3.2, Klein Goldewijk et al.)
owid_hyde_land.license: CC BY 4.0 (OWID's); HYDE 3.2 is CC BY 3.0
owid_hyde_land.note: World cropland, compared with World3's arable land. Not vendored.

gistemp.name: NASA GISTEMP v4 global annual mean surface temperature anomaly (mirror datasets/global-temp on GitHub)
gistemp.license: Public domain (US Government work); mirror under ODC-PDDL
used_in: carbon and climate of the L0 (V4)
gistemp.note: Anomaly over 1951-1980. HadCRUT5 (the truth of F4) was not reachable in the V4 session. Not vendored.

gcam_fossil_curves.name: GCAM fossil resource supply curves (A11.fos_curves.csv) and primary fuel carbon coefficients (A_PrimaryFuelCCoef.csv), JGCRI/gcam-core
gcam_fossil_curves.vintage: commit 11e128f; curves from GCAM 3.0, derived from Rogner (1997)
gcam_fossil_curves.note: World fossil occurrences by fuel and cost grade (EJ, 1975 USD per GJ) and kg C per GJ. An assessment from 1997, not a measurement: the unconventional grades are speculative. Not vendored.

bp_reserves_2016.name: OWID owid-datasets: Reserves-Production Ratio - BP Statistics (2016) and Fossil fuel production BP & Shift (2022), World rows
bp_reserves_2016.license: CC BY 4.0 (OWID's); BP's and The Shift Project's for the underlying data
bp_reserves_2016.note: Proved reserves of 2015 = reserves-to-production ratio x production. A check, not an input of the model. Not vendored.

ucdp_ged.name: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset (GED) Global 26.1 and UCDP Candidate Events 26.0.X
ucdp_ged.note: Licence read on ucdp.uu.se/downloads on 2026-11-16 ('All datasets are free of charge and licensed under CC BY 4.0'). The final GED of year y is published in mid y+1; candidate events are monthly with about one month of lag and only those coded 'Clear' are used. W13 scores against the final GED and its features at the origin use the final GED too (leak D-L2-1). Not vendored: l2_manifest.json.

prio_grid.name: PRIO-GRID 2.0 (API of grid.prio.org): gwno, pop_gpw_sum (GPW v3), capdist, bdist1, excluded (GeoEPR), nlights, mountains, ttime, land cover
prio_grid.license: none stated ('freely available to all interested users', cite Tollefsen, Strand & Buhaug 2012); third-party variables keep their own terms
prio_grid.vintage: v2.0 (codebook of 2016-06-02); yearly variables end in 2010-2014
prio_grid.note: Codebook read through the site on 2026-11-16: no licence text, so it is treated as not redistributable and never vendored. Static in the L2: the cell population is the GPW v3 2010 distribution rescaled to WPP country totals [S]; the country of a cell is the 2014 one.

unhcr_refugees.name: UNHCR Refugee Population Statistics Database (R package 'refugees' 2025.12.3: population, flows, idmc)
unhcr_refugees.note: LICENSE.md of github.com/PopulationStatistics/refugees read on 2026-11-16. The idmc table is the Internal Displacement Monitoring Centre's series as redistributed by UNHCR; IDMC's own terms were not opened [S]. Stocks of year y are treated as known from January of y+1 (optimistic by about six months, declared). UNRWA-mandate Palestine refugees are not included.

vensim_world3_03.name: Output of the Vensim World3-03 model (scenario 1), 5 variables, 1900-2100

pydynamo_world3_03.name: World3-03 equations in DYNAMO syntax (pydynamo)
pydynamo_world3_03.note: Source of the L0 transcription. Its SIMULATION departs from Vensim by up to 12 % (DYNAMO .j timing and a >= switch in 1940), so it is NOT a numerical reference.

pyworld3.name: pyworld3
pyworld3.note: 1974 version with different parameters and structure per its README. Neither used nor copied.
